name: Shared Data Models
description: Pydantic v2 immutable data models forming the inter-component contract for the entire Apprentice system. Organized as a src/apprentice/models/ package with focused submodules: domain primitive types and enums (_types.py), task request/response (task.py), training data (training.py), confidence snapshots (confidence.py), budget state (budget.py), audit entries (audit.py), routing/sampling decisions (routing.py), evaluation results (evaluation.py), model versioning (versioning.py), and a re-exporting __init__.py. All models use frozen=True and strict=True as baseline. Contract models use extra='forbid'; persisted models use extra='ignore' for forward compatibility. Decimal for all monetary fields, AwareDatetime for all timestamps, Annotated domain types for IDs, composition over inheritance, and guaranteed clean JSON round-tripping.

types.name: TaskId
types.description: Annotated[str, MinLen(1), MaxLen(128), Pattern(r'^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$')]. Domain-specific identifier for a task type. Prevents mixup with other string IDs.

types.name: ModelId
types.description: Annotated[str, MinLen(1), MaxLen(256)]. Domain-specific identifier for a model (local or remote). Prevents mixup with other string IDs.

types.name: ConfidenceScore
types.description: Annotated[float, Ge(0.0), Le(1.0)]. A confidence score in the range [0.0, 1.0]. Used throughout the system to drive phase transitions and sampling.

types.name: CostAmount
types.description: Annotated[Decimal, Ge(0)]. Non-negative decimal monetary amount for budget tracking. Decimal ensures exact arithmetic for hard budget enforcement.

types.name: AwareDatetime
types.description: datetime with required tzinfo (timezone-aware). No naive datetimes allowed anywhere in the system. Serialized as ISO 8601 string with timezone offset.

types.name: Phase
types.description: StrEnum representing the current operational phase. Phases are emergent from confidence scores, not manually triggered.

types.name: RoutingDecision
types.description: StrEnum representing where a request is routed.

types.name: EvaluatorType
types.description: StrEnum representing the type of evaluator used for comparing responses.

types.name: BudgetPeriodUnit
types.description: StrEnum for budget period granularity.

types.name: EvaluationResultType
types.description: StrEnum discriminator for the EvaluationResult discriminated union.

error_cases.name: invalid_task_id

functions.name: create_confidence_snapshot
functions.description: Constructs a ConfidenceSnapshot. Derives the phase from the score and the two thresholds (threshold_phase2, threshold_phase3) using the rule: score < threshold_phase2 => PHASE_1, threshold_phase2 <= score < threshold_phase3 => PHASE_2, score >= threshold_phase3 => PHASE_3.

inputs.name: sample_count
inputs.description: Number of samples that contributed to this score.

inputs.name: last_updated
inputs.description: Optional timestamp. If absent, current UTC time is used.

error_cases.name: invalid_thresholds
error_cases.condition: threshold_phase2 > threshold_phase3 or either is out of [0.0, 1.0]

error_data.detail: threshold_phase2 must be <= threshold_phase3 and both in [0.0, 1.0]

postconditions: Returned ConfidenceSnapshot.phase is correctly derived from score and thresholds
If score < threshold_phase2 then phase == PHASE_1_REMOTE_ONLY
If threshold_phase2 <= score < threshold_phase3 then phase == PHASE_2_SAMPLING
If score >= threshold_phase3 then phase == PHASE_3_LOCAL_PRIMARY
Snapshot is frozen

functions.name: create_budget_state
functions.description: Constructs a BudgetState. Computes remaining = total_budget - spent and is_exhausted = remaining <= 0.

inputs.name: request_count
inputs.description: Number of requests that incurred cost.

inputs.name: last_updated
inputs.description: Optional timestamp. If absent, current UTC time is used.

postconditions: remaining == total_budget - spent
is_exhausted == (remaining <= 0)
BudgetState is frozen

functions.name: record_cost
functions.description: Returns a new BudgetState with cost added to spent, remaining decremented, and is_exhausted recomputed. Uses model_copy for immutable update. This is the ONLY way to update budget state.

inputs.name: timestamp
inputs.description: Optional timestamp for the update. If absent, current UTC time is used.

error_data.detail: Cost to record must be non-negative

postconditions: Returned BudgetState.spent == original.spent + cost
Returned BudgetState.remaining == original.total_budget - (original.spent + cost)
Returned BudgetState.is_exhausted == (returned.remaining <= 0)
Returned BudgetState.request_count == original.request_count + 1
Original budget_state is not mutated
Returned BudgetState is a new frozen instance

functions.name: serialize_model
functions.description: Serializes any data model defined in this component to a JSON string using Pydantic's model_dump_json(). Guarantees clean round-trip serialization.

inputs.name: model_instance
inputs.description: Any Pydantic model instance defined in this component.

error_cases.name: not_a_pydantic_model
error_cases.condition: model_instance is not a Pydantic BaseModel

error_data.detail: model_instance must be a Pydantic BaseModel

error_cases.name: serialization_error
error_cases.condition: Model contains non-serializable fields (should not happen with well-formed models)

preconditions: model_instance is an instance of a Pydantic BaseModel defined in this component
postconditions: Returned string is valid JSON
Calling deserialize_model with the result and the model's type returns an equivalent instance
Decimal fields are serialized as strings to preserve precision
AwareDatetime fields are serialized as ISO 8601 strings with timezone

functions.name: deserialize_model
functions.description: Deserializes a JSON string back into a typed Pydantic model instance using model_validate_json(). Performs full validation on deserialization.

inputs.name: model_type
inputs.description: The name of the model type to deserialize into (e.g. 'TaskRequest', 'BudgetState'). Must be one of the types defined in this component.

error_cases.name: unknown_model_type
error_cases.condition: model_type does not match any defined model

error_cases.name: validation_error
error_cases.condition: JSON data does not conform to the target model's schema

error_cases.name: extra_fields_forbidden
error_cases.condition: JSON contains extra fields and the model uses extra='forbid'

preconditions: json_data is a valid JSON string
model_type is one of the model type names defined in this component
postconditions: Returned instance is of the specified model_type
Returned instance passes all Pydantic validation
Returned instance is frozen if the model type is frozen

functions.name: validate_model
functions.description: Validates raw data (dict) against a model type without constructing the full model. Returns a list of validation errors or an empty list if valid. Useful for pre-flight validation.

inputs.name: model_type
inputs.description: The name of the model type to validate against.

error_cases.name: unknown_model_type
error_cases.condition: model_type does not match any defined model

preconditions: model_type is one of the model type names defined in this component
postconditions: Returns empty list if data is valid against the model type
Returns one or more ValidationErrorDetail items if validation fails
Does not raise exceptions — all validation issues are captured in the return value

functions.name: get_model_json_schema
functions.description: Returns the JSON Schema for a model type. Useful for documentation, config validation, and client SDK generation.

inputs.name: model_type
inputs.description: The name of the model type.

error_cases.name: unknown_model_type
error_cases.condition: model_type does not match any defined model

preconditions: model_type is one of the model type names defined in this component
postconditions: Returned dict is a valid JSON Schema (Draft 2020-12 compatible via Pydantic)
Schema includes all field definitions, types, constraints, and descriptions

invariants: All model instances with frozen=True are immutable after construction — no field can be reassigned
All models with extra='forbid' reject any fields not explicitly defined in the schema
All models with extra='ignore' silently discard unknown fields (forward compatibility for persisted state)
All CostAmount fields use Decimal arithmetic — no floating point for monetary values
All timestamp fields are timezone-aware (AwareDatetime) — naive datetimes are rejected at validation
All models round-trip cleanly through JSON: model_validate_json(model.model_dump_json()) produces an equivalent instance
Phase is always derived from ConfidenceScore and thresholds, never set independently
EvaluationResult is a discriminated union — the result_type field determines which variant is active
TaskId values match the pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*$ and are between 1 and 128 characters
ModelId values are non-empty strings of at most 256 characters
ConfidenceScore values are always in the closed interval [0.0, 1.0]
No model in this component performs I/O, network calls, or mutates global state — all functions are pure
Composition over inheritance: no model type inherits from another model type in this component
